title: OLAP for Software Engineers
description: A software-engineering-first approach to data engineering on top of the base infrastructure. MooseStack provides typed schemas, automated migrations, built-in MCP server, and hot-reloading dev environment. The agent works within a unified framework instead of wiring independent tools.
installScript: bash -i <(curl -fsSL https://fiveonefour.com/install.sh) 514@0.64.0 && ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/514" /usr/local/bin/514 && bash -i <(curl -fsSL https://fiveonefour.com/install.sh) moose@0.6.514 && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.moose/bin:$PATH" && MOOSE_VERSION="0.6.514" && MOOSE_BIN=$(find "$HOME/.moose/versions" -path "*/$MOOSE_VERSION/moose" | head -n 1) && [ -n "$MOOSE_BIN" ] && ln -sf "$MOOSE_BIN" "$HOME/.moose/bin/moose" && ln -sf "$MOOSE_BIN" /usr/local/bin/moose && mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills" && if 514 agent init --agent claude-code --yes; then true; else node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const home=process.env.HOME; const configPath=`${home}/.claude.json`; fs.mkdirSync(`${home}/.claude/skills`, { recursive: true }); let root={}; try { root=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, "utf8")); } catch (error) { root={}; } root.mcpServers={...(root.mcpServers||{}), "moose-dev": { type: "http", url: "http://localhost:4000/mcp" }, "context7": { type: "http", url: "https://mcp.context7.com/mcp" }}; fs.writeFileSync(configPath, `${JSON.stringify(root, null, 2)}\n`);'; fi && mkdir -p /opt/dec-bench/moose && cd /opt/dec-bench/moose && npm init -y && npm install @514labs/moose-lib@0.6.514 && CH_VER=25.8.18.1 && CH_VER_LTS=${CH_VER}-lts && ARCH=$(uname -m) && if [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then CH_ARCH=arm64; PLAT=linux-aarch64; elif [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then CH_ARCH=amd64; PLAT=linux-x86_64; fi && CH_CACHE="$HOME/.moose/binaries/clickhouse/${CH_VER_LTS}/${PLAT}" && mkdir -p "$CH_CACHE" && curl -fSL "https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/releases/download/v${CH_VER_LTS}/clickhouse-common-static-${CH_VER}-${CH_ARCH}.tgz" | tar xz -C "$CH_CACHE" && chmod +x "${CH_CACHE}/clickhouse-common-static-${CH_VER}/usr/bin/clickhouse" && echo "Pre-cached ClickHouse ${CH_VER_LTS} for moose dev --dockerless"
